item.text: The defect is localized: the editor starts with the visible fallback device ID, but the save check needs to compare against the stored name. I’ll make that change and add a test for an unnamed device saved with its ID as the name.

The five device and session suites pass, including the new regression test: 54 tests and 19 snapshots. Jest emitted warnings from the existing session tests, but there are no test failures. I’ll do a final diff check and record the result in the checkpoint.

item.text:
Fixed the rename defect: saving the device ID as the name of an unnamed session now calls `saveDeviceName`. Added a regression test covering that save and a subsequent unchanged save.

The five device and session Jest suites pass: 54 tests and 19 snapshots. `git diff --check` passes. No TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM.
